From hotel managers and front desk staff to housekeeping, chefs, and support teams, every member of our team is dedicated to providing high-quality service with a welcoming attitude. Many of our staff speak multiple languages and are always ready to assist, whether you need travel tips, help with transportation, or simply a friendly face during your stay. We're here to make your experience in Hanoi as smooth and enjoyable as possible. OUR UNIQUE HOTELS We operate 16 hotels nestled in Hanoi’s Old Quarter, just steps from iconic landmarks like Hoan Kiem Lake, the Night Market, and the Temple of Literature. Designed to suit every type of traveler, our collection includes local vibrant boutique hotels, comfortable standard hotels, and luxury hotels with rooftop bars, fine dining, and stunning views. Whether you’re a single traveler, a family, or a couple on a romantic getaway, each of our hotels is thoughtfully crafted to deliver a satisfying experience in the heart of the city. OUR VISION AND CORE VALUES With a passion for delivering high-quality travel services at unbeatable costs, we strongly support local travel suppliers and communities across the country. We strive to bridge the cultural gap between foreign travelers and locals, creating meaningful connections that benefit people all around. At Sun Flower Hotel Company, we don’t just offer a place to stay; we create memorable experiences that satisfy both our guests and the communities we serve. CONTACT US We are always ready to welcome you!
